name: Bits Limited
summary: BITS Limited, an Indian enterprise, primarily focuses on the management and operation of educational institutions. It delivers instruction across a diverse range of subjects, including the arts, commerce, sciences, both computer software and hardware, business and hospitality management, and various engineering and technical disciplines. In addition to its educational ventures, the firm is also active in property leasing and the administration of different learning environments, such as training centers, schools, colleges, universities, and remote education programs. Established on November 27, 1992, the company maintains its principal office in New Delhi, India.
